description: The listing price per ticket needed to break even on resale tickets after the seller fee, with the net per ticket at that price and a one-line explanation. Works without an account. TixSight (tixsight.com) tracks this automatically for a whole ticket inventory.

buyer_fee_percent.description: Buyer fee, as a percent of the listed price (default 0). Buyer fees sit on top of the listed price: the buyer pays them, so they don't change your break-even. The answer shows what the buyer pays.

cost_per_ticket.description: What you paid per ticket, in US dollars, including any fees you paid when buying.

extra_costs.description: Other costs for the whole order in US dollars, such as delivery (default 0). Spread evenly over the tickets.

seller_fee_percent.description: Seller fee the resale site takes out of your payout, as a percent of the listed price (default 10).

name: break_even_price
title: Break-even listing price
